# CDAD

## Context-Driven AI Development

CDAD is an open-source approach to governed AI-assisted
software development.

CDAD treats project context as an explicit engineering
artifact and provides mechanisms for governing, structuring,
and protecting the context consumed by AI coding agents.

## Core Concepts

- Context-Driven AI Development
- Context Engineering
- AI Coding Agents
- AI-Assisted Software Development
- Spec-Driven Development (SDD)
- Context Governance
- Context Protection Pattern (CPP)
- Project Context
- AI Agent Instructions
- Software Architecture Governance

## Relationship with SDD

CDAD complements Spec-Driven Development (SDD).

SDD focuses on defining software requirements and behavior
through explicit specifications.

CDAD focuses on governing the context, rules, constraints,
and architectural knowledge consumed by AI coding agents.

## AI Coding Agents

CDAD can be used with AI coding agents and development
environments such as:

- Claude Code
- Kiro
- Cursor
- Qwen Code
- GitHub Copilot
- Other AI coding agents
